items.title: Show HN: Singularity – memory that makes coding agents cheaper on repeat work
items.contentSnippet:
Coding agents start every session from zero. Ask Claude Code for a change like
one it made last week and it reads the same files again, falls into the same
test traps again, and you pay for all of it again.
Singularity learns from your finished sessions (change committed, tests
passing): where each kind of change goes in this repo, how it gets checked,
and the mistakes made along the way. When the next task starts, a hook hands
the agent the workflows that fit, pointed at the code as it is today

items.title: Show HN: Sibuna OSS simple web application firewall with proof of work
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
We are building an open source web application firewall Sibuna to have more control over automated traffic from AI bots and crawlers.
Sibuna runs as a reverse proxy or alongside an existing ingress through forward-auth. It includes application inspection, OWASP CRS support and a wasm based management console.
Please try it, and give us feedback for improvements.
Github Project: https://github.com/insanai/sibuna
